page.intro: Start with inference fundamentals and service dataflow, then use PD co-located or PD separated to estimate weights and HBM; switch to KV Cache sizing when you need sequence memory. Co-located mode supports all models; separated mode can improve performance but only for specific deployment patterns on selected models.

notes.mixed: Calculation notes: This is a simplified estimate; quantization follows the model name. Framework and runtime overhead reserves 10% of per-card HBM capacity. Actual deployment also depends on the inference framework.
notes.separated: Calculation notes (PD separated): Total weight size matches co-located mode. Total cards split into Prefill and Decode pools (half each), then into groups by P groups / D groups; each group deploys one full copy of weights, sharded across cards in the group. Per group: model usage per card = total weight GB ÷ cards in group, plus 10% of per-card HBM for framework/runtime. Main view and charts show the bottleneck side (higher total usage per card on Prefill vs Decode).
notes.kvcache: Calculation notes (KV Cache): Industry-standard sizing (see KV Cache Sizing): standard GQA KV_bytes = 2 × L × num_key_value_heads × head_dim × seq_len × batch_size × dtype_size. Qwen3.6 (hybrid attention): L_full × 2 × H_kv × head_dim × seq_len × batch_size × dtype_size (FP16 @ 1M ≈ 19.1 GiB; linear layers excluded). DeepSeek R1 / V3.1 (MLA): L × (kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim) × seq_len × batch_size × dtype_size (W4A8 / W8A8 use A8 → INT8 KV, 1 byte/element; W4 affects weights only). GLM-5.1 (MLA + DSA): L × seq_len × batch_size × [(kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim + DSA_index_head_dim) × dtype_size + indexer_scale] (W8A8 @ 1M ≈ 51.4 GiB; MLA-only ≈ 41.8 GiB). DeepSeek V4 (CSA/HCA): BF16 @ 1M anchor × (dtype_size / 2) × seq_len ratio (V4-Flash W8A8 ≈ 4.81 GiB, BF16 baseline 9.62 GiB ÷ 2).

capacity.heading: Capacity planning
capacity.intro: Combine model usage with cluster topology to assess whether compute and memory meet target concurrency and latency. Start with Agentic inference · HBM estimate above for per-card usage, then aggregate across the dimensions below.
capacity.clusterBody: Sum available memory as card count × per-card HBM capacity and compare with sharded model usage per card to see headroom for KV, buffers, and replicas.
capacity.scaleBody: Insufficient HBM leads to inference failures—add cards or adjust quantization first. For long sequences with high cache hit rates, multi-tier KV Cache can improve throughput and reduce latency.
capacity.hint: Tip: Estimates on this site are simplified; formal capacity planning should include benchmarking, framework versions, and business SLOs.

msg.kvcNoProfile: KV profile parameters not configured for this model.
msg.quantW8A8Note: W8A8 deployments often use INT8 KV (1 byte/element, ~half of FP16)
msg.quantW4A8Note: W4 affects weights only; KV Cache follows A8 activations as INT8 (1 byte/element)
msg.quantDefaultNote: Unrecognized quantization suffix; assume BF16/FP16 KV (2 bytes/element)
msg.quantFp16Note: KV Cache as FP16 (2 bytes/element); linear attention layers do not store full KV per token
msg.v4FlashNote: CSA/HCA sequence compression; BF16 @ 1M ≈ 9.62 GiB, W8A8 KV halved ≈ 4.81 GiB
msg.v4ProNote: Same V4 compression family; BF16 anchor extrapolated from Flash × (L×H_kv)_Pro / (L×H_kv)_Flash
msg.kvcFormulaMlaDsa: MLA+DSA expansion: L {layers} × seq_len {seqLabel} × batch_size {batchSize} × [({compressedKvDim} + {ropeHeadDim} + {dsaIndexHeadDim}) × dtype_size {dtypeBytes} + indexer_scale {indexerScale}] = {perLayerPerTokenBytes} bytes/token/layer ≈ {bytes} bytes (≈ {gib} GiB). Full model per token {bytesPerToken} bytes (≈ {kibPerToken} KiB). MLA-only ≈ {mlaOnlyGib} GiB; vs standard GQA expansion ≈ {standardGib} GiB. {quantNote} MoE expert count {experts} not multiplied into KV.
msg.kvcFormulaMla: MLA expansion: L {layers} × (kv_lora_rank {compressedKvDim} + qk_rope_head_dim {ropeHeadDim}) × seq_len {seqLabel} × batch_size {batchSize} × dtype_size {dtypeBytes} ({quantLabel}) ≈ {bytes} bytes (≈ {gib} GiB). {perLayerPerToken} elements per layer per token; full model per token {bytesPerToken} bytes (≈ {kibPerToken} KiB). vs standard GQA expansion ≈ {standardGib} GiB. {quantNote} MoE expert count {experts} not multiplied into MLA KV.
msg.kvcFormulaQwen: Hybrid attention: L_full {fullLayers} × 2(K/V) × H_kv {kvHeads} × head_dim {headDim} × seq_len {seqLabel} × batch_size {batchSize} × dtype_size {dtypeBytes} ({quantLabel}) ≈ {bytes} bytes (≈ {gib} GiB). {bytesPerLayer} bytes per layer per token; full model per token {bytesPerToken} bytes ({linearLayers} linear attention layers excluded). vs if all {totalLayers} layers were full-attention GQA ≈ {naiveFullGqaGib} GiB. {quantNote} MoE expert count {experts} excluded.
msg.kvcFormulaV4: V4 compressed estimate: BF16 baseline {bf16AnchorGiB} GiB @ seq_len {anchorSeqLen} × (dtype_size {dtypeBytes} / 2) ≈ {anchorKvGiB} GiB @ 1M × (seq_len {seqLabel} / {anchorSeqLen}) × batch_size {batchSize} ≈ {bytes} bytes (≈ {gib} GiB). vs standard GQA expansion ≈ {standardGib} GiB. {anchorNote} MoE expert count {experts} excluded; ~{bytesPerToken} bytes per token (incl. architecture compression).
msg.kvcFormulaStandard: Expansion: 2(K/V) × L {layers} × num_key_value_heads {kvHeads} × head_dim {headDim} × seq_len {seqLabel} × batch_size {batchSize} × dtype_size {dtypeBytes} ({quantLabel}) ≈ {bytes} bytes. ~{bytesPerToken} bytes per token (batch excluded). {quantNote} MoE expert count {experts} excluded.
